title: Home Health — Smart Triggers

terminology.syntheticBanner: SYNTHETIC library cases — not real patients. Layer 1 params are placeholders.

previews.silent_log: Silent log: record only, no human task
previews.nurse_task: Nurse queue: contact within about 24 h
previews.provider_task: Provider queue: same-business-day review, not a page

rulesTable: Layer 1 alone decides the route. The headset does not call a cloud model.
Routes, lowest to highest: silent_log, nurse_task, provider_task, urgent_page.
A device_maintenance ticket is shown when Layer 1 files one. Clinical routes do not keep a ticket.
Pass accepts the Layer 1 route. Modify picks another route. urgent_page alerts the Urgent page node.

glossary.home health: Synthetic home-monitoring case. Layer 1 proposes a route for you to pass or change.
glossary.urgent page: Layer 1 route urgent_page: page someone now. Signing it alerts the Urgent page node.
glossary.device ticket: Optional device_maintenance ticket from Layer 1. Not a clinical page. Clinical routes do not keep one.
glossary.bridge offline: The localhost Layer 1 bridge is not running. The card shows the bundled snapshot from the same engine.
glossary.Layer 1: Deterministic smart-trigger engine (v1.14.4, params 0.14.4-placeholder). Live badge means the bridge recomputed this case. Bundled means the snapshot shipped in the app.
glossary.route: silent_log logs only. nurse_task is nurse contact. provider_task is same-day clinician review, not a page. urgent_page pages now.
glossary.plain reason: Short reason text from Layer 1 for this decision.
glossary.Vignette: Fact text copied from the synthetic case library. Not a real chart.
glossary.Layer 1 decision: Route, owner, rule, and device ticket from Layer 1.
glossary.Who: Age band, sex, and living situation from the library case.
glossary.Problems: Problem list copied from the library case.
glossary.Medicines: Medicines copied from the library case.
glossary.Devices: Home devices copied from the library case.
glossary.Goals: Patient goals copied from the library case.
glossary.Function: Function baseline copied from the library case.
glossary.Baseline: 30-day baseline numbers copied from the library case. Placeholders, not validated.
glossary.Baseline status: Learning or established phase copied from the library case.
glossary.Discharge: Discharge field copied from the library case.
glossary.Device flags: Artifact flags copied from the library case.
glossary.Trend: Seven-day trend text copied from the library case.
glossary.Note: Caregiver or nurse note copied from the library case.
glossary.Library file: Which synthetic library file this case was copied from.
glossary.Owner: Which Layer 1 rule owner produced the route.
glossary.Tier: Trigger tier (ABSOLUTE, CONFIRM_FIRST, SUPPRESSED, ARTIFACT) when Layer 1 had one.
glossary.Escalation target: Who would be paged when Layer 1 names a target. Otherwise none.
glossary.Device ticket: device_maintenance when Layer 1 files a ticket, otherwise none.
glossary.Ticket detail: Why the ticket was filed, from Layer 1.
glossary.Ticket note: Extra note when a ticket is conditional and not filed.
glossary.Decision source: live bridge or the bundled snapshot.
glossary.Params: trigger_params.json version. Every threshold is a placeholder.
glossary.Library label: The synthetic library's expected_route. Layer 1 does not read it. Shown so you can compare.
glossary.priority: Higher cards sort above lower ones in Up next. The Now card stays until you decide it.
glossary.what happens next: Where this route goes if you pass it, including a device ticket when Layer 1 filed one.
